marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.subtitle: Find, install and update modules for this panel.

detail.title: Module
detail.offDescription: Turn on the marketplace on its page to see this module.

switch.title: Connection to the marketplace
switch.description: The marketplace is off. While it is off, the panel makes no request to it.
switch.descriptionOn: The marketplace is on. The panel contacts it only when you open this page or press a button on it.
switch.hostNotConfigured: No marketplace host is configured on this server.
switch.confirmOnQuestion: Enter your password to let the panel contact the marketplace.
switch.confirmOffQuestion: Enter your password to stop the panel from contacting the marketplace. Installed modules keep working.

password.label: Your current password
password.hint: The panel asks for your password again before it changes modules.

available.emptyDescription: The marketplace has no modules to offer this panel right now.
available.noResultsDescription: Change the search, or clear it to see every module.

unverified.title: The catalogue could not be verified
unverified.installsOff: Installing and updating are unavailable until the catalogue can be verified. Installed modules are not affected.

unreachable.title: The marketplace could not be reached
unreachable.description: The panel and the installed modules are not affected. Try again in a moment.

installed.emptyTitle: No modules installed from the marketplace
installed.emptyDescription: Modules you install appear here with their version and state.
installed.dataKept: The module is removed and its data is kept.
installed.revoked: This version was withdrawn by the marketplace.
installed.name: Module

updates.notChecked: Updates are checked only when you press Check for updates.
updates.upToDateTitle: All modules are up to date
updates.upToDateDescription: No newer version was found for the installed modules.
updates.name: Module

manifest.title: What this module can do
manifest.agentCapabilities: Parts of the server it reaches

install.title: Install {name}
install.warning: A module runs inside the panel with the panel's own access. Check what it declares before you install it.
install.acknowledge: I understand that this module runs inside the panel and can reach the parts of the server listed above.
install.manifestMissing: The panel has no summary of this module's manifest to show.

update.title: Update {name}
update.acknowledge: I understand that the new version runs inside the panel and can reach the parts of the server listed above.

remove.title: Remove {name}
remove.question: The module stops after the next restart of the panel. Its data is kept, and installing the module again brings it back.

rollback.title: Roll back {name}
rollback.question: The module returns to its previous version after the next restart of the panel.

operation.failedKept: Modules that were running keep running.

restart.title: Restart required
restart.description: {name} is installed and starts after the panel restarts.
restart.confirmQuestion: The panel is unavailable for a short time while it restarts.
restart.restartingDescription: This page checks the panel until {name} is ready. It can take up to two minutes.
restart.timeoutTitle: The panel has not come back yet
restart.timeoutDescription: Wait a little and reload the page. If it stays unavailable, check the server.
